text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve over time without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses artificial neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us unlock our phones with face recognition, suggests films on streaming platforms, powers voice assistants, and even helps doctors find diseases. AI is changing the world quickly.
